top_signals.title: Ukraine’s former defense minister launches ‘Manhattan Project’ for killer robots
top_signals.summary: Mykhailo Fedorov told Defense News he wants humanoid-like robots on the battlefield within six months and an assault without infantry within a year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Banks Add Rare Lender Protection to Nestle Water Debt Deal
top_signals.summary: A group of banks led by Bank of America Corp. and Deutsche Bank AG offered a rare concession to help get a €2.8 billion ($3.2 billion) financing deal for Platinum Equity’s acquisition of a stake in Nestle SA’s water business across the line.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Germany Tells State-Owned SEFE to Store Gas as Winter Nears
top_signals.summary: The German government has instructed state-owned energy company SEFE Securing Energy for Europe GmbH to procure and store natural gas in the coming weeks as the region faces pressure to bolster unusually low inventories before winter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Transparency data: Trade Specialised Committee on Administrative Co-operation in VAT and Recovery of Taxes and Duties
top_signals.summary: Meeting agendas and summaries for this joint UK-EU forum for combatting VAT fraud and recovering claims related to taxes and duties.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
